note: *porque já não há santo*: held against the Latinist's major (*desapareceu o santo*, which he had passed on draft 1). The blind reader heard the perfect as one man's death; D27 lists it against the gate.

*quem é o nosso senhor?* in lower case, with Matos Soares 1932, keeps both readings (no master, so not the Lord either). The final Latinist asked the capital, which names God; aloud there is no difference.
*dos carentes* for *ínopum* (D38): *indigentes* was unknown to four blind readers out of four. *desvalidos* (Matos Soares 1932) stays an option; HANDOFF asks you to pick one word for *inops*.

*As palavras do Senhor são palavras puras*: *elóquium* decided locally as *palavras* (D27). The stylist refused *ditos castos*; *castos* was heard as sexual chastity. The final Latinist asked *palavras castas*, option 5.
